actions.name: screen.read
actions.title: See the operator's screen
actions.description: Says which admin page the operator has open, its heading, and the actions that can run there. Changes nothing.

actions.name: screen.go
actions.title: Open a page of the admin panel
actions.description: Opens a page of the admin panel on the operator's screen, such as /shippin/admin/keys, so they see where the work happens. Only admin panel pages. Changes nothing.
